```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "
    <!ENTITY ent 'expanded value'>
    <!NOTATION png SYSTEM 'image/png'>
    <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM 'ext.png' NDATA png>
  ">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment testing parser states -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <child>&ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % dtdAttr "
    <!ATTLIST item code ID #IMPLIED>
  ">
  %dtdAttr;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="compiler" data="validate=true"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       with special chars <>&'" -->
  <item code="i1" xlink:type="simple">
    &ent2;
  </item>
  <item code="i2">
    <![CDATA[Raw data &ent1;]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY standard "Standard Stock">
  <!ENTITY complex "&standard; with additions">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % externalMacro SYSTEM "http://example.org/macro.dtd">
  %externalMacro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inv" xmlns:m="http://example.org/inv/meta">
  <!-- Nested processing and comments -->
  <m:details>
    <?m:action execute?>
    <![CDATA[
      <stock>Nested CDATA block</stock>
    ]]>
  </m:details>
  <stock>&complex;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Value">
  <!ENTITY beta "α -> Beta Value">
  <!ENTITY % inner "
    <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY gamma 'Gamma Value'>
  ">
  %inner;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" destination="stdout"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:log="http://example.org/archive/log">
  <!-- Comment highlighting entity expansions -->
  <record log:level="info">
    β γ
  </record>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA text with entities like β (unexpanded)
    ]]>
  </record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY baseEntity "Base">
  <!ENTITY refEntity "&baseEntity; Reference">
  <!NOTATION xmlNotation SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY extEntity SYSTEM "external.xml" NDATA xmlNotation>
  <!ENTITY % pe "
    <!ENTITY localPeEntity 'PE Value'>
  ">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/doc/ns">
  <!-- Comprehensive test case with all rare elements -->
  <ns:section ns:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block inside namespaced element.
    ]]>
    &refEntity; &localPeEntity;
  </ns:section>
</document>
```
